notes:
Mostly fixes, and one AI that had quietly stopped saving is back.

## Highlights

- :srcLittlebird: **Littlebird chats are saved again** Littlebird's desktop app moved where it keeps your chats in early October, and ChatsRecall stopped finding them. Everything since then comes in on your next sync.
- :search: **New accounts can search sooner** A first sync now makes each AI's 25 newest chats searchable, text included, before that AI's sync ends. The rest arrive in the background.

> Claude, Grok, Perplexity, AI Mode, Meta AI, pacing

## Improved

- A first sync now has each AI's 25 newest chats ready to search however it was started: from the setup tour, from the Sync page or by the schedule. Pinned chats no longer take one of those 25 places. The Sync page says so in words: "Your 25 newest Claude chats are ready to search; the rest arrive in the background."
- Syncs leave a few seconds between requests to the same site (longest for Google and ChatGPT), so sites are less likely to show a CAPTCHA or slow you down. A sync can take a little longer. Saving a chat as you send it is not slowed down.

## Fixed

- Littlebird has saved nothing since early October. Its desktop app (0.84 to 0.86) moved your chats and meetings into a new file, and ChatsRecall only knew the old one. It now reads the new file, read-only, and writes nothing into Littlebird's folder. Nothing was lost, nothing is saved twice, and you aren't asked about a new account.
- Deleting a Google AI Mode conversation from ChatsRecall failed with "couldn't read Google AI Mode's request token" after a change on Google's side. It works again.
- Meta AI conversations are read in full again after another change on Meta's side.
- Pinning, deleting or moving a Perplexity thread works again when Perplexity opens its thread menu as a panel at the bottom of the window.
- Continue in Perplexity types your text into Perplexity's new prompt box again.
- A Claude prompt sent from another device just after ChatsRecall saved that conversation could be skipped by the next sync. It is read now.
- The first prompt of a new Grok chat is saved as soon as Grok has answered, instead of up to ten minutes later.
